server_url.title: Server Address
server_url.description: The address you open your server at, for example http://192.168.1.20:4533 or https://music.example.com.

quality.title: Streaming Quality
quality.description: "app" follows the quality you chose in Jellyfesh for each network; the other values always use that quality on this server.

transcode_format.title: Format When the Server Converts
transcode_format.description: What the server converts to when a file is above the chosen quality or in a format Jellyfesh cannot play.
